links.outcome: Acceptability of LLM outputs versus periodontist reference on same vignettes
links.effect: GPT o1 Pro 86.7% and Claude Sonnet 4 85.6% acceptable ratings, comparable to periodontist (87.8%); Gemini 2.5 Pro lower (59.4%; P<.002).
links.quote: GPT o1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4 showed strong performance, with 86.7% and 85.6% of ratings deemed acceptable-comparable to the periodontist's output (87.8%).

screen.reason: The study is an empirical vignette-based evaluation comparing the performance of multimodal LLMs against a human periodontist for periodontal risk assessment, without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
